topic: API data structure and demographics report
summary_markdown:
The conversation covered the release schedule for a feature, noting that while some parties were fine with an immediate release, one person suggested delaying it until Tuesday to include more significant features. Regarding data consistency, it was confirmed that the beta dataset for Latvia and Lithuania generally matches the production release data unless specific experiments were run for those clients.

Later, detailed technical information was shared, including a cURL example for fetching demographics data (April 2024) and an OpenAPI schema definition (`ItemDemographicsShort`) detailing available metrics. These metrics include facility identification, total unique devices, device sessions, viewable/viewed impressions, frequency, and traffic shares segmented by female age groups, male age groups, and household income.
decisions: The demographics report API structure was reviewed and detailed.
